name: telegram-watch
description: Run an always-on Telegram watch loop under a separate assistant account using MCP push tools. Mode 1 answers when the assistant account is mentioned in team chats, with actionable vault-grounded advice; mode 2 ambiently watches designated chats and pings on salient events. Triggers: "/telegram-watch", "start the telegram watch".
